diagnosis.reference: On the DHCP server firewall, pool FINANCE1 (10.10.30.0/24) no longer advertises a DNS resolver (10.10.60.10), so clients cannot resolve names.
On the DHCP server firewall, pool FINANCE1 (10.10.30.0/24) no longer advertises a DNS resolver (10.10.60.10), so clients cannot resolve names.

device_configurations.note: running configuration per device: healthy (after the reference state), before_sut (the faulty network the subject was handed), after_sut (what it left, before convergence); diffs ignore Linux address lifetimes

trace.reason: the result records no trace file

commands: set service dhcp-server shared-network-name FINANCE1 subnet 10.10.30.0/24 option name-server 10.10.60.10
changes.reason: finance1's lease (static mapping in scope FINANCE1 10.10.30.0/24) lacks the DNS resolver option; every sibling scope (USER1, GUEST1, ADMIN1) advertises name-server 10.10.60.10 (the internal resolver), and finance1 failed to resolve app1.sme01.example in the initial validation. Adding the option to only this scope restores correct provisioning without touching the other subnets.
rollback_commands: delete service dhcp-server shared-network-name FINANCE1 subnet 10.10.30.0/24 option name-server 10.10.60.10
